legend: Retinal cone cells (Cone Cells) are mainly concentrated in the fovea of the macula and are responsible for color vision and high-resolution vision. Due to differences in their light absorption spectra, their distribution ratios are significantly asymmetric:
S-cones (short-wavelength / blue): about 2% – 10%, and they are absent in the very center of the fovea.
This distribution explains why the human eye is most sensitive to green light (covered jointly by L and M cones), while its spatial resolution for pure blue is relatively low.
yyz likes the color blue. To find the most beautiful shade of blue, she keeps collecting it using magic. For a beautiful photo, yyz will first transform it into a blue Hilbert curve.
Specifically, there are n$$$n$$$ color blocks arranged from left to right. The i$$$i$$$-th block contains an amount of blue element bi$$$b_i$$$.

When yyz starts casting magic, she will give an incantation l r x$$$\texttt{l r x}$$$, which means: extract all blocks in the array interval [l,r]$$$[l, r]$$$ that satisfy bi≥x$$$b_i \geq x$$$. After a block is extracted once, it will lose all of its blue elements.
Given q$$$q$$$ magic casts, please tell yyz how many blue elements can be extracted each time.
input: The first line contains two integers n,q$$$n, q$$$ (1≤n,q≤2×105$$$1 \leq n, q \leq 2 \times 10^5$$$) — the number of blocks and the number of queries.
The second line contains n$$$n$$$ integers b1,b2,⋯,bn$$$b_1, b_2, \cdots, b_n$$$ (1≤bi≤107$$$1 \leq b_i \leq 10^7$$$) — the amount of blue elements in the i$$$i$$$-th block.
Each of the next q$$$q$$$ lines contains three integers l,r,x$$$l, r, x$$$ (1≤l≤r≤n$$$1 \leq l \leq r \leq n$$$, 1≤x≤107$$$1 \leq x \leq 10^7$$$) — a query interval and the threshold value.
output: Output q$$$q$$$ lines. For each query, output one integer: the total amount of blue elements collected in the i$$$i$$$-th magic operation.

legend.ai: 视网膜锥细胞（锥细胞）主要集中在黄斑的中央凹中，负责色觉和高分辨率视觉。由于它们的光吸收光谱存在差异，它们的分布比例明显不对称：
L 型锥细胞（长波长／红色）：约 60%–64%。
M 型锥细胞（中波长／绿色）：约 30%–32%。
S 锥体细胞（短波长/蓝色）：约占 2%–10%，并且在中央凹的最中心处缺失。
这种分布解释了为什么人眼对绿光最敏感（由 L 锥体细胞和 M 锥体细胞共同感知），而其对纯蓝色的空间分辨率相对较低。
yyz 喜欢蓝色。为了找到最美丽的蓝色色调，她不断用魔法收集蓝色。为了拍出美丽的照片，yyz 会先将其转换成一条蓝色希尔伯特曲线。
具体来说，有 n$$$n$$$ 个颜色块从左到右排列。第 i$$$i$$$ 个颜色块中含有数量为 bi$$$b_i$$$ 的蓝色元素。
当 yyz 开始施展魔法时，她会给出咒语 l r x$$$\texttt{l r x}$$$，其含义是：提取数组区间 [l,r]$$$[l, r]$$$ 中所有满足 bi≥x$$$b_i \geq x$$$ 的颜色块。一个颜色块被提取一次后，就会失去其中全部的蓝色元素。
给定 q$$$q$$$ 次施法，请告诉 yyz 每次可以提取出多少蓝色元素。

input.ai: 第一行包含两个整数 n,q$$$n, q$$$(1≤n,q≤2×105$$$1 \leq n, q \leq 2 \times 10^5$$$)——块的数量和查询的数量。
第二行包含 n$$$n$$$ 个整数 b1,b2,⋯,bn$$$b_1, b_2, \cdots, b_n$$$(1≤bi≤107$$$1 \leq b_i \leq 10^7$$$)——第 i$$$i$$$ 个块中蓝色元素的数量。
接下来的 q$$$q$$$ 行中的每一行包含三个整数 l,r,x$$$l, r, x$$$(1≤l≤r≤n$$$1 \leq l \leq r \leq n$$$，1≤x≤107$$$1 \leq x \leq 10^7$$$)——一个查询区间和阈值。

output.ai: 输出 q$$$q$$$ 行。对于每次查询，输出一个整数：在第 i$$$i$$$ 次魔法操作中收集到的蓝色元素总数。
